questions.question: Piyush buys 4 blankets at the rate of ₹450 per blanket. He sells these 4 blankets to Gopi and earns a profit of 12% on his investment. Gopi further sells all 4 blankets to Pritam and earns 15% profit. What is the price at which Pritam bought one blanket?
questions.solution:
**Given : Piyush buys 4 blankets at the rate of ₹450 per blanket. **

**Explanation :**

Cost price of 4 blankets at the rate of ₹450 per blanket = (4 × 450) ⇒ ₹1800

So, Piyush buys 4 blankets at the cost of = ₹1800

Now, According to the question

 
• He sells these 4 blankets to Gopi and earns a profit of 12% on his investment. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c1fcb75bdd2e152f178c0d96f59f5db29c072b3cc49c2c3eeb5abd863846645e.png] ​

So, Piyush sold at the profit of:

= 1800 (12/100)

= Rs 216

Selling price = Cost price + Profit 

= 1800 + 216

= Rs 2016

 
• Gopi further sells all 4 blankets to Pritam and earns 15% profit.

​

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7cf0b9fffa232c5ce8b6f41c1fd582d1f4713b5f9dc1989cb2f4004a4db8fa62.png] 

So, Gopi sold at the profit of:

= 2016 (15/100)

= Rs 302.4

Selling price = Cost price + Profit 

= 2016 + 302.4

= Rs 2318.4

​Thus, according to the question the price at which Pritam bought one blanket is:

For 4 blankets cost price for Pritam is = Rs 2318.4

Therefore, **for 1 blanket cost price is = 2318.4/4 ⇒ Rs 579.6**

Hence, **"****₹579.60"** is the correct answer.
